review.tagline: Full-stack SaaS monorepo template on React 19, tRPC and Cloudflare Workers
review.summary: A GitHub template for SaaS apps split into three Cloudflare Workers (Astro marketing site, React 19 SPA, Hono and tRPC API) joined by service bindings. Better Auth handles email OTP, passkeys, Google OAuth and organizations, with optional Stripe subscriptions. Drizzle ORM talks to Neon PostgreSQL through Hyperdrive, provisioned with Terraform.
review.audience: TypeScript teams building a SaaS on Cloudflare's edge
strengths: Auth, organizations and Stripe billing are already wired in
One TypeScript type contract from Drizzle schema through tRPC to the React UI
Separate migrate and deploy scripts for staging and production, same script in CI
A merge-seed skill pulls upstream template changes into your project
weaknesses: Tied to Cloudflare Workers, Neon PostgreSQL and Hyperdrive; no alternative runtime documented
Requires Bun 1.4+ instead of Node.js and npm
README describes no built-in AI features; they must be added yourself
Email OTP sign-in needs a verified Resend domain for users other than you
needs: Needs Cloudflare Workers, Neon PostgreSQL, Bun, Resend, Stripe (optional), Terraform
